name: codex-forge
description: A Codex-native development pipeline for planning issues, implementing changes, convergent review, and shipping pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, review, and ship changes with Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex-native plan → work → finish → ship workflows with project profiles, stack-aware review perspectives, and convergent defect verification.
defaultPrompt: Use $forge-plan to turn this request into an implementation-ready Issue.
Use $forge-work to implement this Issue or small task.
Use $forge-finish to finish and review the current branch.
